title: KT-EGO: A Knowledge Transfer Assisted Efficient Global Optimization Algorithm for Solving High-Dimensional Expensive Black-Box Problems
abstract: arXiv:2609.37473v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many engineering problems involve optimizing a high-dimensional expensive black-box (HEB) design space. To solve such problems efficiently, we propose a knowledge transfer assisted efficient global optimization (EGO) algorithm, labeled as KT-EGO, which extends the EGO algorithm for solving problems over higher dimensions (i.e., $d>20$). Specifically, the original design space is divided into several low-dimensional subset design spaces. More importantly, in order to extract information from the subset design spaces to accelerate the progress of full optimization, we propose a surrogate-based data fusion strategy in KT-EGO. And further, a searching strategy with an adaptive variable range is devised to enhance the exploitation of promising areas. translated_title: KT-EGO：一种知识迁移辅助的高效全局优化算法，用于求解高维昂贵黑盒问题
translated_abstract: 许多工程问题涉及对高维昂贵黑盒（HEB）设计空间的优化。为了高效地求解此类问题，我们提出了一种知识迁移辅助的高效全局优化（EGO）算法，称为KT-EGO，该算法将EGO算法扩展至求解更高维度（即 $d>20$）的问题。具体而言，将原始设计空间划分为若干低维子设计空间。更重要的是，为了从子设计空间中提取信息以加速全空间优化的进程，我们在KT-EGO中提出了一种基于代理模型的数据融合策略。此外，还设计了一种具有自适应变量范围的搜索策略，以加强对有前景区域的开发利用。为了展示所提算法的有效性，我们将其与最先进的算法在12个基准测试函数以及一个28维的工程设计优化问题上进行了比较。
tldr: 提出KT-EGO算法，通过将高维设计空间分解为低维子空间、基于代理模型的数据融合策略以及自适应变量范围的搜索策略，将EGO算法成功扩展至求解20维以上的高维昂贵黑盒优化问题。
en_tdlr: KT-EGO extends the EGO algorithm to solve high-dimensional expensive black-box optimization problems (d>20) by decomposing the design space into low-dimensional subspaces, employing a surrogate-based data fusion strategy for knowledge transfer, and utilizing an adaptive variable range search strategy.
